# PlyPal Plywood Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.

> Plywood manufacturer and exporter in Belthangady, Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka, India (near Mangaluru). Will make MR grade plywood (IS 303), BWP plywood (IS 710), blockboard (IS 1659) and calibrated plywood in standard 8 x 4 ft sheets. Production at the Belthangady factory starts in early 2027; enquiries are open now. Will sell factory-direct to dealers, carpenters, contractors, architects and home owners in India, and takes export enquiries from the UAE and GCC.

## Products
- MR grade plywood, IS 303: indoor furniture and interiors in dry areas. https://plypal.in/mr-plywood/
- BWP plywood, IS 710: waterproof phenolic bond for kitchens, bathroom vanities and humid coastal homes. https://plypal.in/bwp-plywood/
- Blockboard, IS 1659: solid timber core for doors, long shelves and tabletops. https://plypal.in/blockboard/
- Calibrated plywood: sanded to an even thickness for modular furniture and laminates. https://plypal.in/calibrated-plywood/

## Export
Export-quality MR plywood, BWP marine plywood (IS 710), plyboard and blockboard in 1220 x 2440 mm sheets (HS code 4412). Export enquiries welcome from the UAE (Dubai, Sharjah, Abu Dhabi, Ajman), Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain. https://plypal.in/export/

## Where
Factory: Parappu, Gerukatte Post, Belthangady, Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka 574214, India.
Takes enquiries from Dakshina Kannada, Udupi and the rest of Karnataka.
